main_workflows.codeql.yml:
name: CodeQL
# Advanced CodeQL setup (S11) for JavaScript/TypeScript and the GitHub Actions
# workflows themselves. Keep repository "default setup" disabled: GitHub
# rejects advanced-setup uploads while default setup is enabled. Results are
# separate code-scanning checks, not part of the same-workflow `check` gate.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 21 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('codeql-pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('codeql-run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [javascript-typescript, actions]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # Source-only extraction: no dependency install, build or secrets.
      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@24c54180a607b1449ed407dd24f251e4e9147c8d # v4.38.3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          build-mode: none
          queries: security-extended
      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@24c54180a607b1449ed407dd24f251e4e9147c8d # v4.38.3
        with:
          category: /language:${{ matrix.language }}
main_workflows.production-backup.yml:
name: Production backup
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "25 19 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  backup:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'Rugby-Thailand/industrial-sas' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    environment: production-release
    concurrency:
      group: industrial-sas-production-release
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
        with:
          cache: "false"
      - name: Create and verify a fresh native snapshot
        env:
          RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT: production
          CONVEX_BACKUP_ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_BACKUP_ADMIN_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/release/backup.mjs --purpose=daily
      - name: Retain public backup metadata
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: production-backup-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: release-output/backup-metadata.json
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
main_workflows.quality.yml:
name: Planner quality
# One workflow owns the merge gate and the automatic release. PRs (including
# forks and Dependabot) run only the secret-free quality jobs and the stable
# `check`. A push to main — or a workflow_dispatch from main, which reruns full
# CI rather than bypassing it — then deploys that exact commit to staging and,
# only after staging passes, to production. There is no manual approval step.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
# PRs: one group per PR, superseded runs cancelled. Every other run gets its own
# group (run_id), so rapid merges never replace a pending main check. Release
# serialization lives on the staging/release jobs below, not here.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('planner-quality-pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('planner-quality-run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      # Later steps run even if an earlier check failed, so one run reports
      # every independent defect; any failed step still fails the job.
      - name: Workflow lint and action pins
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/validate-workflows.mjs --verify-pins
      - name: Formatting
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm format:check
      - name: Typecheck (cold next typegen + tsc)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm typecheck
      - name: Lint
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm lint
      - name: Runtime dependency audit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm audit:prod
      # High/critical across all app and release-tool dependencies; only the
      # exact-chain, expiring entries in scripts/ci/dependency-exceptions.json
      # are accepted. Registry errors fail.
      - name: Application dependency audit (exact-chain exceptions)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs --scope=app
      - name: Release-tool dependency audit (exact-chain exceptions)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs --scope=release
      - name: Test discovery
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm ci:test-discovery
      - name: Clean tree after generators
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm ci:clean-tree

  codegen:
    name: Convex codegen freshness
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      # Credential-free anonymous local backend; refuses any CONVEX_* variable.
      - run: pnpm ci:codegen
      - name: Clean tree after codegen
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm ci:clean-tree

  test:
    name: Tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      # Every Vitest project, split by native sharding. Each shard's own exit
      # status gates `check`; its native JUnit file is the report. Combined
      # coverage runs in the scheduled/manual `Workspace matrix` workflow.
      - name: Vitest shard
        run: >-
          pnpm exec vitest run
          --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/3
          --reporter=default
          --reporter=github-actions
          --reporter=junit
          --outputFile.junit=test-results/vitest-junit/shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-3.xml
      - name: Upload shard JUnit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: vitest-junit-${{ matrix.shard }}
          # Re-running a failed shard replaces only its own report.
          overwrite: true
          path: test-results/vitest-junit/shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-3.xml
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

  # One leg per suite; `needs.browser.result` is success only if both pass.
  # Smoke owns the only production build in this workflow. The Vite
  # workspace harness needs no Next.js build.
  browser:
    name: Browser (${{ matrix.suite }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [smoke, workspace]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: Cache Next.js build
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'smoke' }}
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .next/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-next-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', '.nvmrc') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-next-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml', '.nvmrc') }}-
      # No service credentials: this is the unconfigured production-mode build.
      - name: Production-mode build (credential-free)
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'smoke' }}
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Clean tree after build
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.suite == 'smoke' && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm ci:clean-tree
      # Exactly the browser revision bundled with the locked @playwright/test.
      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        id: browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Anonymous smoke (desktop and mobile)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.suite == 'smoke' && steps.browsers.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD: "1"
        run: pnpm test:e2e
      - name: Storage workspace (PR subset)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.suite == 'workspace' && steps.browsers.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: pnpm test:e2e:workspace
      - name: Upload browser JUnit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: browser-junit-${{ matrix.suite }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: test-results/${{ matrix.suite }}-junit.xml
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
      # Failure-only, credential-free synthetic diagnostics (traces/screenshots).
      - name: Upload browser diagnostics
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: browser-diagnostics-${{ matrix.suite }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            test-results/${{ matrix.suite }}/
            playwright-report/${{ matrix.suite }}/
          retention-days: 5
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  dependency-review:
    name: Dependency review
    # PR-only by design; `check` accepts its skip only on push/dispatch.
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@a1d282b36b6f3519aa1f3fc636f609c47dddb294 # v5.0.0
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: runtime, development, unknown
          # Narrow, expiring exception only (no patched release exists). Must
          # match an unexpired entry in scripts/ci/dependency-exceptions.json;
          # validate-workflows.mjs enforces this, so expiry breaks the PR gate.
          allow-ghsas: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
          comment-summary-in-pr: never

  # Stable quality merge gate; CodeQL has separate required checks. Failed,
  # cancelled, missing or unexpectedly skipped jobs never produce a green check.
  check:
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [validate, codegen, test, browser, dependency-review]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: scripts/ci
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Require all quality jobs to pass
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REQUIRED_JOBS: validate,codegen,test,browser,dependency-review
          PULL_REQUEST_ONLY: dependency-review
        run: node scripts/ci/aggregate.mjs

  # Trusted stable staging for this exact commit. Fork/PR code never reaches
  # it: the job runs only for main push/dispatch after `check` succeeded.
  staging:
    name: Staging release
    needs: [check]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check.result == 'success' && github.repository == 'Rugby-Thailand/industrial-sas' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://industrial-sas-staging.vercel.app
    concurrency:
      group: industrial-sas-staging-release
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # Vercel Trusted Sources: the controller requests the configured
      # audience and hands browsers only a refreshed private token file.
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      outcome: ${{ steps.release.outputs.outcome }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
        with:
          cache: "false"
      # Standalone locked workspace: no --ignore-workspace, which would drop
      # its security overrides.
      - name: Install release tools
        run: pnpm -C tools/release install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Deploy and verify staging
        id: release
        env:
          RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT: staging
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          CLERK_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLERK_SECRET_KEY }}
          # Read-only; the controller's stale-main check.
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_ACKNOWLEDGED_DEPLOYMENTS: ${{ vars.RELEASE_ACKNOWLEDGED_DEPLOYMENTS }}
        run: node scripts/release/run.mjs --target=staging
      - name: Upload staging manifest
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: staging-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            release-output/manifest.json
            release-output/smoke-staging.json
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # Automatic production release of the same commit. One job holds the shared
  # production lock (also used by the daily backup workflow) across backup,
  # remote build, candidate smoke, promotion and live checks.
  release:
    name: Production release
    needs: [check, staging]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.check.result == 'success' && needs.staging.result == 'success' && needs.staging.outputs.outcome == 'STAGING_PASSED' && github.repository == 'Rugby-Thailand/industrial-sas' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    environment:
      name: production-release
      url: https://app.thaipropertyai.com
    concurrency:
      group: industrial-sas-production-release
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
        with:
          cache: "false"
      - name: Install release tools
        run: pnpm -C tools/release install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      # Production Convex/Clerk deploy credentials stay in Vercel. The
      # controller takes the mandatory backup before any deployment.
      - name: Release production
        id: release
        env:
          RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT: production
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          CONVEX_BACKUP_ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_BACKUP_ADMIN_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_ACKNOWLEDGED_DEPLOYMENTS: ${{ vars.RELEASE_ACKNOWLEDGED_DEPLOYMENTS }}
        run: node scripts/release/run.mjs --target=production
      - name: Upload release manifest
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: production-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            release-output/manifest.json
            release-output/backup-metadata.json
            release-output/smoke-candidate.json
            release-output/smoke-live.json
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn
main_workflows.security-audit.yml:
name: Security audit
# Scheduled advisory scan between commits (S12). PRs are covered by
# dependency review and the audits inside `Planner quality`.
#
# - runtime: production dependencies, high/critical. Mandatory, no exceptions.
# - gated: all app and release-tool dependencies, high/critical. Mandatory;
#   only exact-chain, expiring entries in scripts/ci/dependency-exceptions.json
#   are accepted, so an expired exception or newly disclosed advisory fails.
# - full: every severity. Informative while the dev/tool baseline is
#   established; findings become warnings, audit outages still fail.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "5 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: security-audit-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  runtime:
    name: Runtime and high-severity audit (mandatory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: Runtime dependencies
        run: pnpm audit:prod
      - name: Application dependencies (exact-chain exceptions)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs --scope=app
      - name: Release tools (exact-chain exceptions)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs --scope=release

  full:
    name: Full audit (informative)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: Application (all severities)
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-summary.mjs --dir=.
      - name: Release tools (all severities)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.setup.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: node scripts/ci/audit-summary.mjs --dir=tools/release
main_workflows.workspace-matrix.yml:
name: Workspace matrix
# Scheduled full storage-workspace matrix (T5/T14): widths 320/768/1024/1440
# × Thai/English × light/dark against the deterministic Vite harness, plus
# informational full-suite Vitest coverage (T12) in a parallel job. No
# backend, no authentication, no secrets; fixtures are synthetic. It never
# deploys anything and is not part of the merge gate (PRs run a subset and
# collect no coverage).
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "40 20 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: workspace-matrix-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  matrix:
    name: Full workspace matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Full matrix
        env:
          WORKSPACE_FULL_MATRIX: "1"
        run: pnpm test:e2e:workspace
      - name: Upload JUnit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: workspace-matrix-junit-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: test-results/workspace-junit.xml
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
      # Failure-only synthetic diagnostics from the fixture harness.
      - name: Upload diagnostics
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: workspace-matrix-diagnostics-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            test-results/workspace/
            playwright-report/workspace/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # Combined coverage of every Vitest project in one unsharded run, so the
  # numbers describe the whole suite. Informational: no thresholds. V8
  # instrumentation puts the heaviest emulated-backend import test (seven full
  # snapshots, ~1,470 full-table scans) at 4.4–5.0 s against Vitest's 5 s
  # default, so only this coverage run gets a 15 s budget.
  coverage:
    name: Full-suite coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: Vitest with coverage
        run: >-
          pnpm exec vitest run
          --coverage
          --coverage.reportOnFailure
          --testTimeout=15000
          --reporter=default
          --reporter=github-actions
          --reporter=junit
          --outputFile.junit=test-results/vitest-junit.xml
      - name: Upload coverage and JUnit
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: vitest-coverage-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            test-results/vitest-junit.xml
            coverage/coverage-summary.json
            coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
